payload.message:
Generate and publish today's Prompt Pack for aicofounderstack.com. 1. PICK TOPIC: python C:\Users\compj\.openclaw\workspace\scripts\content-nova\prompt_pack_gen.py --site aicofounderstack.com Returns JSON with 'topic' and writing instructions. State at scripts/content-nova/prompt-pack-state.json tracks 30-day no-repeat. 2. WRITE PROMPTS: Following the 'instructions' string from step 1, write exactly 3 highly refined prompts on the topic. Output JSON: { "title": "Daily Prompt Pack: - ", "excerpt": "", "intro_html": "

1-2 sentence intro with a hook and the topic line.

", "prompts": [ {"tag": "[Claude]", "body": ""}, {"tag": "[ChatGPT]", "body": ""}, {"tag": "[Cursor]", "body": ""} ], "footer_html": "

Full archive at aicofounderstack.com/tag/prompt-pack.

} Rules: under 80 words per prompt, tool-tagged bracket prefix, force specificity, deliver one tangible artifact. 3. HUMANIZE WRAPPER COPY (NOT the prompts): The 3 prompts are the product and MUST stay verbatim - Opus rule, no exceptions, 100% accuracy required. Apply the humanizer skill (skills/humanizer/SKILL.md) to: - title (rewrite in natural voice, drop AI tells) - excerpt (same) - intro_html (same) - footer_html (same) Do NOT touch the prompts[].body fields. The cross-poster also runs a mechanical pass on social captions. 4. PUBLISH + CROSS-POST in one call: python C:\Users\compj\.openclaw\workspace\scripts\content-nova\prompt_pack_orchestrator.py --site aicofounderstack.com --content-json '' This will: (a) create the WP post as draft, (b) flip to publish, (c) cross-post to X @AICofounderStack + Bluesky @nova-cofounder.bsky.social + Pinterest (rendered 1000x1500 PNG pin) under the 'nova' upload-post profile. X POST FORMAT (IMPORTANT): - Body has NO URL — X penalizes links in organic posts since 2023 - Body uses bare domain only (e.g. 'Full pack on aicofounderstack.com') - Full URL goes in the first_comment field (upload-post handles this automatically) 5. Deliver a summary to #wordpress: post URL, topic, and any cross-post failures (drafts saved to memory/prompt-pack-social-drafts/). DO NOT skip the cross-post step. DO NOT manually post anything outside the orchestrator script. DO NOT modify the prompts[].body fields during humanization.
